name: PostHog
short: All-in-one developer platform with LLM/AI Observability capturing generations, traces, and costs alongside product analytics, session replay, and feature flags.

plans.name: Free tier
plans.notes: 100,000 LLM observability events per month free (no credit card required); 30-day retention; captures generations, spans, and traces as regular PostHog events with no per-seat pricing.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Usage-based beyond the free tier with automatic volume discounts; no markup on tokens already paid to the model provider.
